title: PUT uses full-replace semantics (title+author required)
evidence: app.py:152 validate_payload(data, partial=False) — a partial PUT returns 400, confirmed by test_app.py:93
suggestion: Acceptable REST design for PUT; document/rename to PATCH if partial updates are desired. No action required.
